name: Renata Glasc
notes: Casts go one at a time: Handshake (Q) and Loyalty Program (E) each have a 0.25 s cast time that keeps Renata busy (no other cast, no attack) until it ends; Bailout (W) has no cast time and costs nothing, but still cannot start inside another ability's cast.

The opening at t=0 is Q, then W, then E, one after another: Q's 0.25 s cast comes first (Q is resolved ahead of same-instant events), then Bailout fires the instant it is free (it costs no time), then Loyalty Program's own 0.25 s cast follows; the first auto-attack therefore lands only once both cast times have elapsed.

Handshake (Q) is cast on cooldown; its recast (the knockback) is modeled as landing within the same 0.25 s cast as the initial hook, since the sources give the ability one cast time and do not state a separate one for the recast (the recast's own 'queue time' is not a cast time) - this gives two magic-damage instances per Q cycle, with the cooldown starting once both land.

Loyalty Program (E) is cast on cooldown for a single magic-damage instance: the dummy is read as being hit once by the missile's arrival (the common reading), not separately by the instant side rockets and the pass-through.

Leverage (P) procs its bonus magic damage on Renata's first attack, since the dummy starts unmarked; against one stationary target the mark only ever refreshes on later attacks and never expires, so it fires exactly once for the whole fight.

Bailout's attack-speed bonus ramps linearly from its base value at cast to double that value at 5 s elapsed (RenataW.MaxStatMultiplier=2, taken as a continuous ramp); it is cast once at the open of the fight (its 24-28 s cooldown is longer than most fight windows) and recast on cooldown if a longer fight allows it. Its movement-speed bonus and ally-targeting are not modeled since movement and allies do not matter in this fight. Bailout deals no damage of its own in this dummy fight: its only effect here is the attack-speed ramp (read through bonus_as) and a fatal-damage save that never triggers against a dummy that never damages Renata, so it has no 'W' damage source.

Hostile Takeover (R) is never cast: it deals no direct damage, and with no allied unit for a berserked dummy to redirect its attention to, casting it only spends its 0.75 s cast time and mana for nothing; its cast time is still recorded at gen.R.castTimeS for documentation but is not read anywhere since the driver never calls cast_r.
Mana costs are not modeled: none of Q/W/E's costs would stop casting inside a 15 s fight at level 16.

assumed.why: Handshake's recast (the knockback) is treated as landing within the same 0.25 s cast as the initial hook rather than costing a further cast time of its own; the dossier gives Handshake one cast time (0.25 s) and states only a 'queue time' for the recast, not a separate cast time.
Bailout's cast time is stated as none by the dossier; the value 0 is used so it can be checked against another cast in progress like every other ability, without itself costing time.
Hostile Takeover's 0.75 s cast time from the dossier is recorded here for completeness even though the driver never casts R (it deals no direct damage in this fight), so the number is never read.

unused.W: Bailout only grants Renata (self-cast) ramping bonus attack speed / movement speed and a fatal-damage-save-plus-burn that never triggers against a dummy which never damages Renata; it deals no direct damage of its own in this fight, so no damage source starts with W. Its attack-speed bonus is applied through bonus_as instead.
unused.R: Hostile Takeover deals no direct damage and its berserk effect has no useful target in a 1v1 dummy fight with no allies, so the driver never calls cast_r; its cast time is kept in the kit only for documentation.
